theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_dsp_pushforward_pair
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), 0 < lam → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) m, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ) K < ∞) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => ξ (a + lam • y)) (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ) ∧ (∀ᵐ y ∂(ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) m, |ξ (a + lam • y) α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∀ (S : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m), ∫ y in S, ξ (a + lam • y) (ω y) ∂(ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ) = lam⁻¹ ^ m * ∫ x in dilation a lam ⁻¹' S, ξ x (ω (dilation a lam x)) ∂μ
